purpose: Phase 2g: ARM-B replication of F4. Encoders see ONLY G_in (1250 genes); decoder predicts G_out (1250 unseen genes). Library-size offset from G_in depth ONLY (no target leak). Gate-independent 4-encoder dispersion contrast (E6'), dataset-clustered inference (E7'), energy-estimator stability (E8').

offset_provenance.source: G_in counts only (raw[:, gin_idx].sum(1)), normalised by train-split mean
offset_provenance.assertion: gin_library_size() asserts G_in/G_out disjoint AND offset != G_out depth; the decoder never sees G_out counts.

gate_note: One-sided gate governs mean/procedure conclusions but NOT the dispersion contrast: poisson_on_nb_mean holds NB's OWN fitted mean fixed in both arms. Reported for all four encoders.
metric_note: r_var_abs_log2_expr = EXPRESSION-RESTRICTED |log2 r_var| (mean count >= 0.5). Unrestricted r_var is discredited. Both metrics lower-is-better; median_paired_diff = nb_stochastic - poisson_on_nb_mean (negative => NB better).
